prayerExcerpt.en-US: St. Hyacinth teaches us to employ every effort in the service of God, and to rely for success not on our own industry, but on the prayer of His Immaculate Mother.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: São Jacinto nos ensina a empregar todo esforço no serviço de Deus, e a confiar para o êxito não em nossa própria diligência, mas na oração de sua Imaculada Mãe.

meta.face: A Pole of about fifty-five with a fair, wind-reddened northern complexion and an OBLONG face with a FLAT-TOPPED crown — a broad, straight forehead, HIGH, ROUNDED cheekbones set wide in the Slavic manner, a SHORT nose with a broad, slightly UPTURNED tip, SMALL, deep-set, pale-blue eyes under slightly heavy lids and straight, fair brows, a WIDE, level mouth, a firm, SQUARISH chin with a shallow CLEFT; CLEAN-SHAVEN, with fair sandy hair turning grey in the Dominican corona; the gaze calm and trusting, lowered to the ciborium. Not the dark, compact peter_verona, the long, full-oval vincent_ferrer, the white-bearded raymund_penyafort or the domed, bald antoninus_florence.
meta.basis: No portrait from life survives. The book's scene (Kiev, the ciborium, the alabaster Madonna, the Dnieper) gives the subject; the face is ours, a Pole of fifty-five (born c. 1185, Kiev sacked 1240), after the Slavic type rather than the dark bearded friar of Carracci's altarpiece.
